notes: Tapping the home-screen widget now resumes the song you were last playing, from the position you left it at, and it starts playing instead of opening the app paused and waiting for a second press.
The press that opens the app is the press that starts the song, so there is nothing new to find in it: one tap on the widget, and the music comes back on.
A tap on a widget whose song is already playing only opens the app. The request for a resume is left only when nothing is playing, so a tap can never restart a song that is running.
The widget play button behaves the same way when nothing is playing: it asks for the last song back rather than pressing play into a player that is no longer there.
The phone player follows the resume too. A song brought back this way shows up on the lock screen and in the shade player the moment it starts, exactly as it does when you press play yourself.
Your lyrics, the letter wave, the player screen and the timings saved on your songs are untouched by this release.
